title: GradingTaskCreate
description: One task as authored inside `GradingBatchCreateRequest.tasks` — the study's (question, document, claimed evidence) triple with nothing the server assigns. `pair_id` is the study's own key for the pair (`<topic>__<doc>` in the R-dev draw) and is the first column of every exported CSV, so it MUST be unique within the batch (422 otherwise). An EMPTY `claims` is a legal task, not a gap: it is the labeler's 'no localizable evidence' verdict (SPEC-confirmation-run.md §6.6.1), which the reader confirms with `correctly-none` or overturns with `missed-evidence`.

pair_id.description: The study's identifier for this (question, document) pair; unique within the batch; the `pair_id` column of the export. Opaque to the server.

stratum.description: The sampling stratum the pair was drawn in (`model_positive`, `model_negative`, `deep_section`, `long_document`, …), recorded before any pair is read (SPEC §6.6.2). Carried through to the export's JSON so per-stratum κ needs no join.

claims.description: The claimed answer: every labeler's evidence sets, unioned, each tagged by source. `set_index` values MUST be unique and every span MUST lie inside `document` (422 otherwise). Empty for a model-negative pair.

extra_questions.description: Additional per-task questions (r3 §11 guard 2). Ids MUST be unique within the task. Default: none.
